info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Market Data Quant Models-spec
info.description: The Market Data Quant Models Retrieval API provides essential access to a list of quantitative models utilized in analyzing market data. This endpoint allows users, particularly financial analysts and data scientists, to seamlessly retrieve a collection of quant models tailored for market analysis. Typical use cases include fetching model specifications for evaluation, integration into analytics tools, or comparative analysis. With this API, developers can enhance their applications with robust market data insights, driving informed decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the latest market data related to quant models, providing essential insights for analysis and decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve quant model data from the market data API. Ensure to include all necessary parameters to filter or specify the required quant model information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the quant model market data.
